detail.longDescription: RE: https:// hachyderm.io/@ericwastl/117521 924122446264 Sounds like from another era: upgrading my vim game This year I'm exclusively using # vim as my editor to tackle the puzzles at https:// adventofcode.com Highly recommend # AdventOfCode as a way to exercise your brain.
